context: Hiroshi-elder watches Goro-grandpa's grandson play in a tennis match.
purpose: Two old men cheering a third generation child athlete.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前の孫、テニス、上手いな!
lines.en: Your grandson plays tennis very well.
lines.style: Warm admiration with the ease of long friendship. Slow, deliberate pace. Voice settles comfortably on the observation, like he's been watching and appreciating quietly.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Small, genuine chuckle at the opening. Quiet pride underneath — not boastful, just matter-of-fact. Soft, content tone. The voice of a grandfather who knows his grandchild's habits by heart.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: I'll cheer loudly for him then!
lines.style: Brightens slightly, still grounded. Light energy — genuine enthusiasm without losing the gentleness. The 'then' lands with a soft decisiveness, like he's committing to the moment.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: おう、おっきい声で頼むわ!
lines.en: Please — make it a big voice!
lines.style: Light request wrapped in quiet humor. Slight lift on 'big,' playful but sincere. Comfortable, familiar tone between two old friends who understand each other without needing much said.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Sharp, genuine cheer — the voice lifts and carries. Bright and full-bodied without being strained. Real encouragement from someone who means it, delivered with the unselfconscious warmth of an elder rooting for the young.
